text.card: A red giant 2,683 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.93 solar masses and 16.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,442 K at its surface.
